ticket.title: S11 adversarial review of the whole epic: admin API + update path + workflow engine first, then installers, PII, codex seat parity
ticket.description:
Design design-e963c656f5 §5 S11. One bounded adversarial round over everything S1–S14 shipped, by an adversary seat on the epic's adversary model (codex gpt-6-astra; per §4.11 Fable if codex were absent).

Targets, in priority order:
1. `/v1/admin/*` authorization, invite codes, token revoke/rotate, the supervisor control port, and Tailscale credential handling.
2. The update path (backup/stop/upgrade/migrate, harness update-when-idle).
3. The workflow engine: Standard parity, pin immutability, lint bypass, custom-role escalation.
4. The installers and desktop app (what they install and where, PATH, uninstall).
5. PII and secrets in the tree and the release artifacts.
6. Codex seat output parity and the consult removal (no dangling callers).
7. Cross-platform claims versus the code.

Findings go on this ticket as `kind=finding`, each with a repro. This story is blocked on every sibling.

chain.title: Productize the app. Make it as installable and independent of machine or OS

criteria.text: Install and run from the release artifacts: on Windows (hands-on), the MSI and, separately, `install.ps1`, each followed by the setup wizard or `<cli> init`, then start, bring up board, MCP, pool and broker with /v1/health 200 and /ui serving, and stop leaves no process. CI install smoke is green on windows, macos and ubuntu for the release commit.

Machine independence: the installed app runs outside any checkout. No `parents[N]` repo-layout derivation, no raw env read outside the registry (test), and no taskkill/powershell/WMI outside Windows-only branches. Grep of the tracked tree and of every release artifact for the user-profile path, `C:\Projects`, the owner's username and email returns 0, and gitleaks is clean.

Codex seats: the consult tools are gone from every bundle and `consult(` is absent from the agent home. The qa and adversary cards spawn a codex adversary seat, and `codex-images.md` is the only codex image guide. Codex seats' developerInstructions carry edp-terse byte-identical to the claude seats' file on start and resume, and a drill shows zero text on an unchanged wake.

Operable from the UI on the live dogfooded install: an admin, with no shell, restarts the board and the pool from Admin → Services; edits settings from every registry group; invites a teammate over the tailnet (the link signs them in on another machine) and revokes them (401); mints a Tailscale auth key; configures and test-pings Slack; and adds a Pi model with any provider in Admin → Models. The S10 empty-band bug is gone.

Configurable workflow: the whole pre-existing test suite is green under the Standard workflow (golden). Lean and Solo presets each walk a tiny epic to done. `/ui/design` publishes a duplicated workflow version that a new epic pins, and running epics are unaffected.

Release and dogfood: a tag v0.9.0 produces a draft GitHub Release, which the owner publishes, with wheels, sdist, vsix, MSI, DMG and deb, carrying the Heronry name and icons throughout (no AppImage, per design v18 §4.9). This host's fleet runs the installed release after the owner's cutover: `<cli> status` shows the installed version, the old checkout's services are stopped, and all epics, tickets and tokens are intact.
